- `apps/desktop/src/features/extensions/registry.ts` — added a `sync` extension flag (off by default), following the existing `security`/`multiLens` pattern.

- `apps/desktop/src/features/profiles/lib/cloud-sync-providers.ts` (new) — a small provider list (`{id, label, defaultPath}`); today just iCloud Drive, so Google Drive/Dropbox later is just another list entry.
- `apps/desktop/src/shared/lib/notes.ts` — extracted `emitTreeInvalidated` (was inline in `use-note-editor.ts`) so it can be reused.
- `apps/desktop/src/app/app-shell.tsx` — refreshes the notes tree on window focus, so changes iCloud synced in the background show up without a restart.

No Rust/core changes were needed — `notes_root` already accepts any absolute path. Typecheck, build, and the vitest suite all pass, and a dev-data launch confirmed no runtime errors.
